# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We pledge to make participation in the Inking community a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, experience, nationality, race, religion, or sexual orientation.

## Our Standards

**Positive behavior:**

- Using welcoming and inclusive language
- Being respectful of differing viewpoints
- Gracefully accepting constructive criticism
- Showing empathy towards other community members

**Unacceptable behavior:**

- Harassment, trolling, or derogatory comments
- Publishing others' private information without permission
- Sexualized language or imagery
- Any conduct inappropriate in a professional setting

## Enforcement

Instances of abusive behavior may be reported to **vikaspal.icu@gmail.com**. All complaints will be reviewed and investigated promptly and fairly.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies within all community spaces, including GitHub issues, pull requests, discussions, and social media.

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1.
